propositions: macOS pytest runs exhibit filesystem bottleneck with excessive git-add/git-commit operations taking 13.69s of 20.19-21.63s total wall time

RAM disk sizing must be bounded below 40% of runner physical memory with at least 50% headroom, determined by measuring local retained temp allocation and file counts from a full test suite run
